transcript: If I'm not at the theater, I'm reading a book. So when I was invited to the Harper Collins offices to celebrate the release of Tahereh Mafi's newest book, release me, obviously I was going. In 2011, I was part of a book club that read Shatter Me. I was obsessed with the original series and so excited for this continuation. If you love dark, yearning dystopian romance, this whole series is for you. But no darkness here today. We got to make our own bouquets. I had such a good time picking out all the flowers. It was like a purple and white. It turned out so cute. I also tried my hand at book bedazzling, and turns out this is really hard. The jewels are tiny, my hands are shaky. I don't actually think I could ever be a surgeon, but I had a great time trying, and we got this far. We also got beautiful copies of Shatter Me, Watch Me, and a sneak peek of Release Me. The best part was still to come. No.. 1 New York Times best selling author, Tahereh Mafi. I was thrilled she was there, and it was so cool getting to hear her talk about the books. Returning to the shatter me universe feels like coming home to familiar care. First spent now 15 years with the thing is always building, like, really exquisite tension and yearning and love. An emotional journey. Release me is out April 7th. I cannot wait. After The talk. She hung out, took photos, and signed all of our books. I literally just blabbered at her for, like, five minutes about how much I love the books, and she was so nice. I think I need to reread the whole series now. Tonight was so great, and I love talking about books.
